name: Duibne

attributes.attribute: patronymic and tribal name of Diarmait Ua Duibne
Irish tribe with Suibne as ancestor-figure

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Duibne names a tribal group and its ancestor. It forms the patronymic of Diarmait Ua Duibne, the romantic hero. Cochrann was the mother of Diarmait Ua Duibne. His nemesis was the great wild boar Donn Ua Duibne. Suibne appears as the ancestor-figure of the Irish tribe Clann Duibne. Koch records Corco Duibne, an early Irish population group. These names tie the hero to his people.
